experiences.name: Diavolezza Glacier Skiing
experiences.description: Experience world-class skiing on the Diavolezza glacier near Pontresina, offering stunning runs with panoramic views of Piz Palü and Bernina peaks. Suitable for intermediate to advanced skiers with over 10km of marked pistes and off-piste opportunities.

experiences.name: Bernina Express Scenic Winter Rail Journey
experiences.description: Board the iconic UNESCO-listed Bernina Express from Poschiavo station, winding through dramatic Alpine landscapes, frozen lakes, and snow-covered viaducts. The route passes the famous Brusio spiral viaduct just minutes from Poschiavo, offering breathtaking winter scenery.
experiences.location: Poschiavo Railway Station, Via Principale, Poschiavo

experiences.name: Cross-Country Skiing on Alp Grüm Trails
experiences.description: Explore serene cross-country ski trails departing from Alp Grüm, a high-altitude stop above Poschiavo accessible by the Bernina railway. Glide through pristine snow with sweeping views of the Palü glacier and the Poschiavo valley below.

experiences.name: Snowshoeing in Val da Camp
experiences.description: Strap on snowshoes and trek through the enchanting Val da Camp side valley near Poschiavo, a quiet and pristine winter wilderness. Guided tours reveal local Alpine flora, frozen waterfalls, and traditional Graubünden stone farmhouses buried in snow.

experiences.name: Traditional Graubünden Fondue & Pizzoccheri Dinner
experiences.description: Warm up after a day on the slopes with an authentic Graubünden dinner in Poschiavo's historic village center. Savor local cheese fondue, hearty Pizzoccheri (buckwheat pasta with alpine cheese and vegetables), and Valtellina wines in a cozy centuries-old stone restaurant.
experiences.location: Historic Village Center, Via Principale, Poschiavo
